principle: When a canonical renderer already satisfies intelligence semantics, close a measured presentation gap with the smallest isolated adapter layer rather than creating a competing renderer.
preconditions: change can be isolated without altering intelligence semantics
execution_pattern: VERIFY exact changed files and intended diff
SEPARATE repository proof from runtime proof
anti_patterns: semantic/data-model changes for a visual gap
claiming runtime verification from source inspection alone
verification_rule: IMPLEMENTED, REPOSITORY-VERIFIED, BUILD-VERIFIED, and RUNTIME-PROVEN are distinct states and must never be collapsed.
reusable_value: Surgical visual elevation can be machine-learned as an architecture-preserving execution pattern.
next_action_policy: Every completed action produces one executable successor action grounded in the new verified state.
